status_policy: All requirements are planned. Presence of foundation code or a helper does not establish full requirement acceptance. Change status only with linked implementation and execution evidence.
scope_note: Covers all 22 audit parity domains plus persistence. Requirements may strengthen or explicitly supersede upstream behavior; source anchors identify the upstream contract, not proof that proposed guarantees already exist.

requirements.requirement: Preserve project creation, attachment, archive, detachment, groups and validated settings.
requirements.acceptance: Import representative projects; reject invalid settings; archive blocks launch; unrelated repository files remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Respect configuration ownership and hands-off repository mode.
requirements.acceptance: Seed only owned configuration; preserve operator edits; hands-off mode performs no unauthorized repository mutations.

requirements.requirement: Represent versioned engine capabilities, supported modes, models and local versus remote execution.
requirements.acceptance: Run an engine/version matrix; unsupported capabilities return explicit refusals; effective mode is recorded separately from requested mode.

requirements.requirement: Preserve managed configuration boundaries and inactive carrier retirement.
requirements.acceptance: Switch engines with user-edited config; retain unmanaged text and remove only owned obsolete carriers.

requirements.requirement: Reconcile native protocol startup, reconnect and indeterminate turn outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Version mismatch fails explicitly; reconnect reconciles thread state; uncertain startup never silently duplicates a turn; model admission precedes ordinary work.

requirements.requirement: Launch through durable intent, stable identity and explicit failure compensation.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent same-ID launch creates at most one process; conflicting payload is rejected; spawn or persistence failures leave a recorded outcome and cleanup evidence.

requirements.requirement: Support attach, input, resize, capture, disconnect and reconnect with bounded buffers.
requirements.acceptance: Slow/no readers do not cause unbounded memory; reconnect returns retained output or an explicit gap; Unicode, resize and EOF behavior are tested.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish API restart survival, host failure and forced cancellation from successful finalization.
requirements.acceptance: API restart preserves the terminal; host failure reports interruption; stale cancellation cannot affect a replacement; unfinished obligations block successful finalization.

requirements.requirement: Preserve project-scoped uploads and prevent path or memory-boundary violations.
requirements.acceptance: Reject traversal, symlink escape, wrong-project access and oversized payloads; verify collisions and interrupted writes without corrupting prior files.

requirements.requirement: Bind ordered context pages and acknowledgments to exact content, revision and launch.
requirements.acceptance: Reject stale revision, wrong digest, missing page and out-of-order acknowledgment; exact legitimate replay is idempotent.

requirements.requirement: Separate ready initialization, model admission, authentication and task authority.
requirements.acceptance: READY cannot grant operator authority; failed preflight or pending model verification blocks work; old launch IDs cannot mutate replacements.

requirements.requirement: Guard automated terminal injection against dialogs, drafts and uncertain send outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Busy, unknown or partially drawn composer refuses unsafe injection; raw operator input remains distinct; lost post-send response cannot trigger blind duplicate delivery.

requirements.requirement: Track stored, rendered and attested-delivered rule versions separately.
requirements.acceptance: Rule retirement updates authority without inventing delivery; omitted rules and empty rule sets remain explicit; disabled hooks stay disabled.

requirements.requirement: Preserve proposals, operator approval, history, promotion and rollback.
requirements.acceptance: Unauthorized promotion fails; approved changes retain provenance and rollback history; engine delivery receipts identify the actual version.

requirements.requirement: Publish handoffs with exact-byte digests and reconciled filesystem/database states.
requirements.acceptance: Crash at staging, rename and database publication boundaries yields deterministic reconciliation; unreadable is distinct from absent; retries preserve publication identity.

requirements.requirement: Preserve transcripts, summaries, memory, provenance and bounded history search.
requirements.acceptance: Fixture import/export retains source attribution and content; large-history search stays bounded and returns explicit partial/unsupported records.

requirements.requirement: Persist send intent, external identity and explicit uncertain delivery outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Crash after remote acceptance but before local binding yields unknown outcome; retry occurs only under a proven remote idempotency contract.

requirements.requirement: Keep delivered, read, acknowledged, replied and terminal facts distinct under reordering.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate/out-of-order facts produce stable projections; dashboard viewing does not acknowledge as an agent; reply obligations survive acknowledgments and restart.

requirements.requirement: Derive workload identity and freshness from verified server context.
requirements.acceptance: Reject spoofed identity and expired/previous-launch receipts; disclose the freshness reason and source of each observation.

requirements.requirement: Separate observed idle from verified availability and safe-to-clear.
requirements.acceptance: Idle alone never authorizes dispatch or clearing; unknown remains unknown; observation budgets are fair under slow terminal probes.

requirements.requirement: Commit HOLD and STOP with notification intent before attempting transport.
requirements.acceptance: Dropped notification and restart preserve mutation refusal; pending notification remains retryable; listener loss cannot remove STOP.

requirements.requirement: Release only named holds with current generation and verified actor authority.
requirements.acceptance: Stale release fails; unrelated holds remain; a role label or sender string cannot substitute for authenticated authority.

requirements.requirement: Preserve master/advisor roles and generation-bound delegated responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance: Role revocation or generation change invalidates prior delegation; concurrent delegates cannot both become authorized successors.

requirements.requirement: Recover checkpoint, successor launch, reconciliation and takeover as durable transitions.
requirements.acceptance: Crash during rotation resumes with one identified successor or explicit uncertainty; copied digest alone cannot attest takeover; blocked handoff retains checkpoint.

requirements.requirement: Preserve ordered default workflow, overrides and explicit capability outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Map every one of the 18 default steps; unavailable/not-applicable differ from success; dependency order is checked; missing capability withholds merge/release authority.

requirements.requirement: Persist step attempts and reconcile external effects before retry, resume or cancellation.
requirements.acceptance: Inject interruption at each effect boundary; capture reuse obeys identity/age restrictions; uncertain commit timeout inspects actual repository state before retry.

requirements.requirement: Preserve unrelated changes and explicit path ownership across Git operations.
requirements.acceptance: Dirty, detached, concurrent-edit and untracked fixtures retain unrelated work; staged paths are explicit; hooks are honored.

requirements.requirement: Keep commit, push, PR, checks, merge and publication as separate verified outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Control change between commit and push withholds push without losing commit; remote races and missing/stale checks prevent false merge completion.

requirements.requirement: Preserve group/project access, locks, revisions and document notifications.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong-project access is denied; stale-base writes fail; lock expiry/concurrent edits preserve revisions and attestation provenance.

requirements.requirement: Model host-scoped ownership, leases, heartbeat and expiry without claiming a bind reservation.
requirements.acceptance: Conflicting leases and real socket bind races report accurately; heartbeat/expiry cannot transfer ownership silently; ingress claims remain distinct.

requirements.requirement: Implement explicit auth states and canonical route exemptions with fail-closed unreadable state.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise every state/path/method combination including encoded aliases; unreadable configuration cannot open access; first-account setup closes after account creation.

requirements.requirement: Preserve account sessions, expiry, revocation, recovery and CSRF guarantees.
requirements.acceptance: Test session rotation, logout CSRF, concurrent recovery and single-use codes; credentials never leak to proxy targets or client-visible diagnostics.

requirements.requirement: Apply consistent authorization to HTTP, WebSocket and local-machine callers.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-origin/unauthenticated upgrades fail; proxied loopback is not a local principal; signed-in operator proof and launch binding remain separate requirements.

requirements.requirement: Preserve connection registry, discovery, tunnels, host fallback and device approval.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise remote disconnect, DNS change, rekey, black-holed SSH and partial startup; unknown service health is not reported as healthy.

requirements.requirement: Protect proxy credentials and sanitize HTTP/WebSocket attribution.
requirements.acceptance: Canary secrets never reach browser payloads/logs/other origins; HTTP and upgrade policy agree; gateway identity and telemetry survive reconnection.

requirements.requirement: Keep operator communication opt-in with scoped routing and confirmation.
requirements.acceptance: Use an opt-in staging account to verify destination, sender identity, confirmation scope and expiry; disabled bridge sends nothing.

requirements.requirement: Preserve helper reconnect and delivery uncertainty without widening authority.
requirements.acceptance: Restart/drop/duplicate tests retain receipts; replay cannot duplicate a confirmed action or manufacture operator approval.

requirements.requirement: Preserve provenance-aware audit scores, baselines, drift and human assessment.
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic fixtures reproduce aggregates; malformed or stale attribution is rejected; unavailable data remains unknown rather than a healthy score.

requirements.requirement: Bound retention and preserve usage-window accounting/calibration semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Verify retention cutoff and retained references; window boundaries and missing provider observations do not invent usage precision.

requirements.requirement: Provide tested service/process ownership on Linux, macOS and native Windows.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh install/uninstall and restart pass on each claimed OS; native Windows PTY/process-tree cleanup has independent evidence; unsupported manager returns actionable status.

requirements.requirement: Preserve ingress, certificate and remote-CA ownership boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Customized ingress is preserved or explicitly reconciled; bad certificates/listeners do not silently expose a supposedly secure service; interrupted provisioning reports partial state.

requirements.requirement: Replace checkout-based updates with explicit versioned upgrade/rollback guarantees.
requirements.acceptance: Interrupted upgrade, disk full and failed startup retain user files and recoverable database; newer schemas refuse unsafe downgrade; running and installed versions remain distinct.

requirements.requirement: Preserve dashboard/project/settings/history flows with generation-safe asynchronous rendering.
requirements.acceptance: Delayed responses never overwrite a newer selection; keyboard focus survives refresh; all parity-ledger flows are reachable through the UI.

requirements.requirement: Preserve bounded reconnect, outage escalation and terminal usability across browsers/devices.
requirements.acceptance: Background throttling and stalled requests still escalate by elapsed time; real browser/mobile tests cover copy/paste, touch keys, viewport resize and pop-out.

requirements.requirement: Deliver coherent frontend generations and truthful cached/offline state.
requirements.acceptance: Upgrade an existing worker from N to N+1; missing assets/auth expiry/cache failure degrade explicitly; streaming responses are not cached as snapshots.

requirements.requirement: Preserve CLI verbs, structured failures and endpoint contracts or version their replacement.
requirements.acceptance: Contract fixtures cover verbs, parameters, exit codes, JSON errors, invalid encoding and per-route size limits; old clients receive explicit compatibility errors.

requirements.requirement: Tie documentation, feature indexing and release evidence to actual shipped behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Documentation checks reject missing shipped features or unsupported claims; release evidence identifies exact commit and executed checks.

requirements.requirement: Maintain isolated test tiers and cross-platform execution evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Pure tests cannot access real subprocesses/services; integration skips remain visible; PR validation uses least privilege and cannot certify unexecuted devices.

requirements.requirement: Preserve mounted sprint/wave tracking, dependency and resource-lease contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent resource claims, expired leases and unmet dependencies produce explicit results; tracked progress is tied to actual evidence.

requirements.requirement: Separate shipped reachable features from helper-only modules and future roadmap commitments.
requirements.acceptance: Each feature has an invocation trace or is labeled preparatory; future multi-user/container/fleet and hierarchy work is not marked completed parity.

requirements.requirement: Preserve transactional decisions, constraints, triggers and domain-owned schema during migration.
requirements.acceptance: Offline import validates rows, references, indexes and triggers; missing constraints refuse/report safely; import never writes to the original database.

requirements.requirement: Keep durable state ownership and schema compatibility explicit.
requirements.acceptance: Only one product writes a database; a newer schema is refused before mutation; crash recovery preserves append-only facts and transaction atomicity.
